book.name: Aisaiya
book.title: Aisaiya Aisaiya Bin Gibit Wed Brom God

content: Det taun gulum Bebalon garra binijap

Wal YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “Yumob pipul langa det taun gulum Bebalon, nobodi bin bidim yumob, bat im garra tjeinj na. Yumob garra gibap yumob speshalwan pawa, en yumob kaan jidan bos enimo. Yumob garra jidan langa det graun.
Yumob deigimat det heinggitjif brom yumob feis en stat grandimap det sid daga. Yumob deigimat yumob purdiwan klos en krosim detlot riba na.
Yumob garra ardimbat nomo lilbit en yumob garra sheim miselp nomo lilbit du brom jidanbat neigidbala, dumaji ai garra stat fait en peiyimbek yumob, en nomo enibodi kaan ranawei.
“Mi na YAWEI det boswan God. Tharran na main neim. Mi na det brabli holiwan God blanga ola Isreil pipul en mi na garra seibum olabat.
“Bebalon yu jidan kwaitbala en langa dakbala. Ola pipul blanga najalot kantri kaan larram yu jidan olabat bos enimo.

Aibin brabli wail langa main pipul olabat, en aibin panishim olabat wen aibin larram yu abum olabat kantri. Aibin meigim olabat jidan nogudbinji en jidan brabli sheimwan. Yu nomo bin fil sori blanga olabat, bat yubin jidan brabli krulbala langa olabat en langa ol detlot ol pipul du.
Yubin reken yu garra jidan bos olataim. Yu nomo bin jinggabat o wori wanim yubin oldei dumbat. Yu nomo bin jinggabat blanga det taim wen yu garra jidan prisana.
“Yu reken miselp, en yu garram detmatj pawa. Yu reken yu kaan lujim yu hasbin, o lujim yu bigininimob. Yu oni jinggabat blanga abumbat gudbala taim olataim. Bat yu lisin wanim ai garra tok na.
Blanga yu klebabala pawa, en yu doktabala ting, dei kaan album yu, en yu garra jidan nomo garram hasbin, en yu garra lujim yu bigininimob. Detlot ting garra hepin kwikbala.

“Yubin oldei dumbat nogudbala ting en yubin reken yubin seifwan. Yubin oldei tok, ‘Nobodi kaan luk langa mi.’ Yubin reken yubin jidan klebabala en sabibala, bat tharran na bin trikimbat yu. En yubin reken miselp yubin jidan boswan blanga ebrijing.
Bat yu kaan gedim eni woning wen det brabli nogudbala trabul garra kaman langa yu, en blanga yu klebabala ting, dei kaan album yu.
Wal yu kipgon yusumbat yu klebabala pawa, en yu doktabala ting, weya yubin dumbat lagijat ola taim. Maitbi, yu garra bradinim sambodi!

Yubin meigim miselp nokap, dumaji yubin oldei askimbat wanim yu garra dum langa detlot pipul hubin oldei lukinatbat detlot sta, en hubin dalimbat yu wanim garra hepin manth afta manth. Wal yu go en askim olabat na hau yu garra jidan seifwan brom det nogudbala trabul weya garra kaman.

“Detlot pipul hu oldei trastimbat ola sta, olabat kaan album yu. Olabat jis laik det gras weya barnap langa bigwan faiya. Nomo enibodi gin jidan wombala brom jidanbat wansaid langa det faiya weya dei oni pudumbat gras.
Brom yangtaim yubin oldei go langa detlot pipul hubin oldei dalimbat detlot klebabalawan stori. Bat olabat nomo sabi weya olabat gogobat, en olabat kaan neba seibum yu, najing.”
